trace_id.description: Trace ID for the review. Only one active review can exist per trace and team.

comment.description: Optional comment or reasoning for the review.

scores.description: Full desired score set for this review. Omit scorers you want to leave blank.

queue_id.description: Optional review queue ID for queue-context saves. When provided, the matching pending queue item is cleared after the review is saved. If omitted, any pending queue item for the same trace is cleared.
